Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Glamour Locks Salon offers a full range of hair and beauty services, including haircuts, coloring, styling, and nail care. Our salon is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service while ensuring the highest standards of hygiene and safety. We use only FDA-approved products and maintain strict sanitation protocols to protect our clients' health. Our skilled staff undergoes regular training to stay updated on the latest trends and techniques in the beauty industry. We also prioritize secure handling of client information to mitigate risks associated with data security.
